  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override

  virtual NotificationPage list_notifications(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit)
  virtual NotificationRead read_notification(const std::string& id)
  virtual NotificationDecision act(const std::string& id, const std::string& action, const std::string& presentation)
  virtual NotificationDecision dismiss(const std::string& id)
  virtual NotificationDecision withdraw_program(const std::string& program)
  virtual NotifierPage list_notifiers(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit)
template<class Transport>struct NotificationOperatorClient : NotificationOperator
  Transport& transport_
  NotificationPage list_notifications(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit) override
  NotificationRead read_notification(const std::string& id) override
  NotificationDecision act(const std::string& id, const std::string& action, const std::string& presentation) override
  NotificationDecision dismiss(const std::string& id) override
  NotificationDecision withdraw_program(const std::string& program) override
  NotifierPage list_notifiers(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit) override
struct NotificationOperatorService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct NotificationOperatorDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  NotificationOperator& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
